Johnson & Johnson (operating as **J&J MedTech**) manufactures a vast array of medical technology, equipment, and devices grouped across four primary areas: Cardiovascular, Orthopedics, Surgery, and Vision.

- **Cardiac Arrhythmia Care:** Diagnostic and treatment tools like the **CARTO 3 Mapping System** and **THERMOCOOL SMARTTOUCH** catheters (by Biosense Webster). [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Johnson_%26_Johnson_products_and_services)

- **Heart Recovery:** Mechanical circulatory support and heart pumps (via Abiomed). [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Johnson_%26_Johnson_products_and_services)

- **Neurovascular:** Stroke and aneurysm treatment tools like the **Embotrap III Revascularization Device** and **Embovac Aspiration Catheter** (by Cerenovus). [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Johnson_%26_Johnson_products_and_services)

### Orthopedics (DePuy Synthes)

- **Joint Reconstruction:** Knee systems (such as the **ATTUNE Knee System**) and hip replacements (like the

**Actis Hip Stem**).

- **Digital Surgery & Trauma:** The **VELYS Digital Surgery** platform and various shoulder, craniomaxillofacial, and trauma repair implants. [](https://www.jnjmedtech.com/en-GB/products)

### Surgery and General Instruments (Ethicon)

- **Wound Closure & Healing:** **VICRYL** sutures, **STRATAFIX** knotless tissue control devices, and **SURGICEL** absorbable hemostats.

- **Surgical Stapling:** Advanced powered and manual endoscopic staplers (like **ECHELON**).

- **Robotic & Advanced Platforms:** The **MONARCH Platform** (for robotically-assisted bronchoscopy) and the **OTTAVA** robotic surgical system. [](https://www.jnj.com/media-center/press-releases/johnson-johnson-announces-monarch-quest-3-advancing-the-latest-in-robotically-assisted-bronchoscopy)

### Vision Care (Johnson & Johnson Vision)

- **Contact Lenses:** The **ACUVUE** brand family.

- **Surgical Ophthalmology:** **TECNIS** intraocular lenses for cataract surgery and equipment like the **CATALYS** Laser System. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Johnson_%26_Johnson_products_and_services)
